title: QoS proportion bar + queue-depth labels + reject toast still draw raw (unscaled) inside the otherwise hud()-scaled panel
evidence: bw := i32((QOS_PANEL_W - 150) * u64(caps[lane]) / max(1, total)); if bw > 0 { rl.DrawRectangle(QOS_PANEL_X + 118, y + 7, bw, 8, cols[lane]) } ... draw_text(app, depth_label, QOS_PANEL_X + 10, qd_y + 3, 14, p.ink_soft) ... draw_text(app, reject_label(app.input.last_reject), QOS_PANEL_X + 10, i32(panel.y + panel.height) - 18, 14, rl.Color{184, 52, 52, 255})
detail: The r6 delta scaled the title, split rows, action buttons, presets and nudges, but these draw calls remain raw constants — geometry drift at x1.25/x1.50.
recommended_fix: Route QOS_PANEL_X offsets, widths, and font sizes through rnd.hud()/hud_f() in these three draw sites.

title: SHEDDING tag keeps raw x+210 / 14px inside the now-hud()-scaled pool gauge
evidence: tag := fmt.aprintf("SHEDDING +%d", e22, allocator = context.temp_allocator); draw_text_c(v, tag, x + 210, y, 14, p.state_critical)
detail: The gauge internals (bar_x 118, bar_w 80) were hud()-scaled in this delta but the SHEDDING tag anchor and size stay raw — overlaps the scaled fill bar at x1.25+.
recommended_fix: hud()/hud_f() the tag's x offset and font size.

title: demolish_button_rect keeps the unscaled nil-view fallback and parity.odin:998 still calls THAT branch
evidence: demolish_button_rect :: proc(pop: rl.Rectangle, v: ^View = nil) -> rl.Rectangle { if v != nil { ... hud_f ... } return {pop.x + 10, pop.y + pop.height - 36, pop.width - 20, 26} } ; harness/parity.odin:998: btn := rnd.demolish_button_rect(pop)
detail: Two geometry variants exist; app + parity.odin:986 pass the view, but parity.odin:998 exercises the raw fallback the app never draws — latent drift.
recommended_fix: Require the view (drop the nil default) and pass one at parity.odin:998.

title: Harness capture computes crisis banner_y from RAW constants while the app now hud()-scales it
evidence: goldens.odin:108: banner_y: i32 = 10 ; 110: banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6 ; app: return rnd.hud(&app.view, 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6)
detail: The r6 delta hud()-scaled the app banner_y (and the health card's own height), so an x1.25/x1.50 golden capture pins banner placement the app no longer draws.
recommended_fix: Route the harness capture's banner_y through rnd.hud() on the capture view.

title: sla_row_rect leaves x=8/width=740 unscaled in an otherwise hud()-scaled pass
evidence: sla_row_rect :: proc(v: ^rnd.View, line: int) -> rl.Rectangle { return {8, f32(sla_row_y(v, line) - rnd.hud(v, 2)), 740, f32(rnd.hud(v, 18))} }
detail: The r6 delta scaled the y-offset and height but kept the raw x/width hit-rect constants.
recommended_fix: hud() the x and width too, or comment why they stay raw.

title: hud_zero_scale test emulates view_compute's guard inline — pins nothing about the product
evidence: v: View ; // emulate view_compute's guard ; if v.ui_scale <= 0 { v.ui_scale = 1.0 } ; testing.expect(t, hud(&v, 440) == 440, "the zero-guard lands on the identity")
detail: The test re-implements the guard instead of calling view_compute; deleting the real guard in view.odin still passes.
recommended_fix: Construct a View, call view_compute, assert ui_scale==1.0.
